about.title: I build internal platforms and workflow-heavy products end to end.
paragraphs: My strongest work sits where product delivery meets operational complexity: internal tools, developer portals, business workflows, and integration-heavy applications across fintech and enterprise teams.
I ship across UI, API, data, and supporting delivery layers, so teams can move without long handoffs between frontend, backend, and platform work.

projects.resumeLine: Portfolio and blog showcasing projects, practical experience, challenges solved, impact, and professional growth.
caseStudy: Built the site with Astro static routes and focused React islands, keeping interactive sections responsive without turning the full portfolio into a client-side application.

Centralized profile, experience, and project data so the website, social card, and one-page resume can be regenerated from consistent source content.
